Episode 207. Elona's Decision
After leaving Hidden Palace, Elona Zipfel walked for a long time across the vast sea.
She did not feel like returning quickly to those who awakened her. Even though she was a person fighting for her family and she had awoken from a thousand-year seal.
Elona was not very happy about this fact. Just like looking into a deep, dark well, it was hard to read her own feelings.
‘A cold wind... it's chilly.'
A person who has reached the spiritual level should not feel cold in such a sea breeze. She was feeling the loneliness of her heart as coldness.
As Ameris guessed, she was born with an unusually strong power from the day she was born, and the reason for it was the obsession of the sun god.
Of course, Elona did not know what kind of power was dwelling in her. The Zipfel of that time was the same.
Transparent footprints were stamped on the sea by Elona. But when she looked back at her footprints, they appeared not transparent but red like blood.
The countless people she had killed a thousand years ago, their blood must have been all over her.
She had never heard pleas for mercy or relief from pain. Because in those days, most of those who met Elona didn't realize the moment they were dying.
Those who had the power to survive after meeting Elona had no reason to hope for mercy. They fought against her like Temar and the Ten Knights or retreated casting curses.
On the battlefield, there was not a single time when Elona backed down first.

‘At that time, I think I wanted to disappear while fighting. Like Temar, with the help of someone who could kill me... Why did I think that? Did I hate my family? Did I not want to kill people anymore?'
She didn't know.
The more she thought, the more her head ached, but she couldn't stop thinking. So when her pain of mind deepened, her magic power unintentionally rose and ravaged the sea.

When the magic power with ice attributes spread, the whole sea froze over, and when the fire magic power erupted, it melted again. The magic power that became the wind created a huge storm in an instant, and lightning struck into it.
All of this was not magic, but merely magic power generated by Elona's mood. If she had been nearby, even a fleet would not have survived and would have become wreckage.
‘Just like this, should I go into the deep sea and not come out? Should I not return to my family? Maybe that would be better. But my family...'
Zipfel, the family she had to protect.
The faces of the members she faintly remembered all had only two expressions. Faces full of fear or contempt.
The former didn't make sense to her. Because she had no intention of hurting the members of her family.
She understood the latter. They had judged that Elona was only strong, but did not properly carry out her mission as a Zipfel.
'Even now, I'm the same as then. While I think I have to fight for my family, I feel confused.'
She wished someone would end this confusion.
The moment she thought that, Elona noticed a group of lights approaching from afar in the dark night sky.
It was Zipfel's First Fleet.
"Korjak...."
Then, the head of the family must be aboard. Elona looked up at the fleet and sorted out her scattered power, and the fleet descended and settled in front of her.
"Zipfel's head, Veradin Zipfel, meets the long-time hero of the family."
Veradin knelt on the frozen sea and spoke. Behind him, the leaders and magicians of the Zipfel family all saluted.
Elona was shocked.
She had never received such a respectful treatment from the family. Although she received formal praise on the day of her promotion, the atmosphere was completely different from now.

That praise was rather close to blame. Why did she miss the chance to kill the Ten Knights, why didn't she completely destroy the city of Runcandel, why does she only do so much despite having that power.
As a result, on the day of the praise, Elona felt suffocated and her chest was tight. Facing the eyes of the family watching her was more painful than anything else.
"I'm sorry for coming to pick you up now. We were insufficient and left you neglected until now."
"...Can you lift your head a little?"
Elona and Veradin's eyes met. Elona couldn't read any contempt, scorn, or falsehood in his words.
"Did you call me?"
"No, it was the Tower of Tales that broke your seal. Embarrassingly, we didn't even know about your existence until the Tower of Tales stepped forward."
"The Tower... called me."
The Tower of Tales, where Elona spent the most time along with the battlefield a thousand years ago.
When she recalled the look of the tower, her vague memories and emotions quickly came back to life.
When she raised magic power in communion with the tower, Elona felt more at ease than ever. The Tower of Tales was her only sanctuary and friend.
"Almost a thousand years have passed, and the Tower of Tales has not disappeared yet. That's why the energy that called me felt so familiar."

"Dare I say, it seems the Tower has been waiting for you, Elona. As I just mentioned, we didn't even know about your existence, but the Tower unsealed you as soon as the conditions were met, even at the risk of my own life."
At those words, Elona felt the loneliness piled up inside her melt like snow. It felt like a long-forgotten friend was embracing her.
"You, the head of the family, were in danger just because of me."
"The Tower decided that you are more important to the family than me, and that is absolute. So don't worry."
"But you said you didn't know anything about me until recently. I'm not worth that much."
"When the Tower unsealed you through me, I glimpsed your life. I would have made the same decision as the Tower."
"Can I go to the Tower of Tales?"

"In the family, Elona, you can do whatever you want. There is no place in the family's land that you can't go, there's nothing in the family that you can't have, and there's no one in the family that you can't command, including me as the head."
Elona had difficulty choosing an answer and just stared at Veradin and his followers for a while.
"Then what do you and the family want from me?"
"Please protect the family."
"That's the only thing I can do, the only thing I know how to do."

"If you wish to help the family out of duty, you have already fulfilled your responsibility a thousand years ago. The incompetent and arrogant ancestors at that time just didn't acknowledge that. If you wish to help the family out of compassion or affection, the current Zipfel is not the family you knew. If you want to help just because it's a request from the head of the family, I won't blame you even if you just refuse."
The more she talked with Veradin, the calmer Elona felt inside.
Soon Elona was able to understand why. Everything he said was providing her with a warmth she had never experienced before.
And the more Veradin read Elona's heart, the angrier he became at the arrogant and foolish ancestors of that time.
'Worthless characters who don't even deserve to be called ancestors, trash. Even on the day of the completion of the Holy Stone, your history will never return to this world.'

When harmonizing with the Tower and unsealing Elona, what Veradin saw was not only Elona's life. He also witnessed the incompetence of that era's Zipfel, which despite having such perfect conditions, was unable to fulfill its ambition.
"Your words are a great comfort to me, Veradin."
"The fact that the hero who protected the family was so lonely is just pitiful."
"Thanks to you, I now know what I want to do."
"Tell me, I'll help with anything."
"I want... to live a better life than before. I want to avoid unnecessary killing, and I don't want to feel lonely when I look back on my day before I go to sleep."
"Should I understand that you want to retire and live a life of giving?"
"No. The Tower called me at the risk of the head's life, so the Tower still loves the family. I feel the same way. I meant that I want to do things for the family and achieve what I just mentioned."
"Then it's understood as wanting to stand on a battlefield full of glory, not meaningless murder, loneliness, and confusion."
"It seems so. I only know how to fight and kill my enemies."
"I can't promise that there won't be any awkward fights. But if there comes a day when you feel painful to go on the battlefield, Elona, you can leave the family at any time."

"I don't want to leave. Under any circumstances, I won't leave as long as the Tower doesn't abandon the family. Instead, since you said that there is no one in the family that I can't command, if such a day comes again as a thousand years ago, then I want to change the family as I wish."
"All of these things do not require my permission, Elona."

"Even so, you are the head of the family. Until such a day comes, I will be a loyal follower serving the head. Also, for some reason, I feel like that day won't come. I have never felt so at ease since I was born."
"You flatter me. But it's true that it feels good to hear you say so."
"So please get up now. It's embarrassing and sorry to have you look up at me, head."
Veradin slowly got up. Elona smiled broadly, a look she had never shown a thousand years ago.
"Well then, I'll take you to the Tower of Tales."

Kojak began to fly to the Tower of Tales. Elona took in the different landscapes from a thousand years ago, looking at the city below the window. Already different from that time, she sincerely wanted to protect those cities.
"Head."
"Tell me, Elona."
"Although a thousand years have passed and there must be a mountain of things I need to learn anew. There's one thing I'm most curious about."
"What is it?"
"Among the enemies of Zipfel now, is there anyone stronger than me?"
Immediately, Veradin thought of Chiron, Vahn, Jin, and Murakan.
"......Elona. Temar Runcandel. What was it like in the era when the first head of the Runcandel was there?"
Elona thought for a moment and then replied.
"I don't think there was anyone at that time."
"Then, it probably isn't any different now."
